name: B10-0174/2026 (ECR) – Case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream regime
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Elene Khoshtaria and political prisoners under the Georgian Dream Regime
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It says Georgia's government, Georgian Dream, has moved the country away from democracy and closer to Russia. It asks Georgia to release people it calls political prisoners, including opposition leader Elene Khoshtaria and former president Mikheil Saakashvili. It also asks the European Union to stop sending money that could reach Georgian Dream officials, to consider sanctions, and to keep watching the situation.

- The European Union is asked to withhold funds that could reach Georgian Dream officials and to consider targeted sanctions.
- The people affected are Georgian political prisoners, protesters, journalists and civil society.
- Next, EU countries decide on sanctions, and the EU office in Tbilisi monitors the situation.
